name: @overdraw/plugin-animations-default
description: Bundled window/layer animation plugin: open/close slides and fades, retile presnaps (immediate and transaction-held), and the two-phase layer-resize glide. Ships with overdraw and claims 'window-opening', 'window-closing', and 'window-animations' at priority 0 (the floor of the priority chain). User configs may override by claiming the same namespaces with a higher-priority plugin; a displaced claim registers no handlers, so there is no double-animation.
